description: Runtz OG is known and loved for its incredibly fruity flavor profile that smells just like a bag of sugary candy we all know and love. Runtz strains are popular for their versatility, suitable for both daytime and evening use.

It provides powerfully relaxing effects coupled with a bright mental euphoria that helps with boosting moods, pursuing creative endeavors, or catching up on a favorite show. GMO x Mai Tai offers strong flavors and aromas that are distinctly reminiscent of savory onions/allium, earthy funk, bright tropical fruit, and hints of diesel.

name: EL CHIVO #5 | 0.5G | 2 PK
description:
El Chivo, translating to "The Goat" in Spanish, is a potent indica-dominant hybrid that lives up to its name by offering an unparalleled cannabis experience. It is a cross between OGKB (OG Kush Breath), Blueberry Headband, and Grape Gas, combining their most desirable traits into a single strain. El Chivo's buds are medium to large, densely packed, and feature glistening white trichomes, a sign of their potency. Their coloration ranges from deep forest green to shades of purple, beautifully offset by fiery orange pistils.

The scent of El Chivo is a combination of exotic scents perfectly combined for the most amazing experience. It is a blend of herbs and spices with a little bit of earth and citrus. Once the dried cannabis is broken open, the aroma is unmatched. It is addicting, to say the least. It tastes fantastic. Initially taking on the herbs and spices, it ends with a hint of citrus and earth. The exhale brings out the pine flavor as an aftertaste and a subtle sweetness, leaving a pleasant taste in your mouth, almost as to entice you for what’s next.

Known for its invigorating qualities, El Chivo is a great option if you want to boost your mood and feelings of inspiration. Upon first partaking, it provides a burst of cognitive acuity, glee, and peace, which makes it perfect for daytime occasions or mixing and mingling in public. These sensations could also spark your creative side and enhance your social charm, turning even the hum-drum into a fun undertaking. As the high wears on, a profound physical ease settles in, which could lead to a restful night's sleep with excessive use. So, practice moderation when enjoying El Chivo.

name: GRAPE BUBBLEGUM | 0.5G | 2 PK
description: Grape Bubblegum is a distinctive hybrid cannabis strain that seamlessly blends the best qualities of its impressive lineage, GMO and Purple Punch. This strain boasts a terpene profile rich in limonene, myrcene, and caryophyllene, which combine to create a sweet and spicy aroma with notes of grape, reminiscent of a vibrant fruit medley. Its flavor profile is equally captivating, with sweet and sour undertones followed by a spicy kick, making every inhale a delightful experience for the taste buds. Known for its potent effects, Grape Bubblegum is favored by both patients and recreational consumers for its ability to induce deep relaxation, provide comfort, and offer effective pain relief. The harmonious balance of its flavors and effects makes Grape Bubblegum a versatile choice for those seeking a strain that covers multiple needs without compromising on taste. Whether unwinding after a long day or seeking therapeutic benefits, this hybrid strain is a standout choice in any cannabis collection.

name: MAC STOMPER | 0.5G | 2 PK
description: MAC x GRAPE STOMPER | If you're looking for something amazing in the flavor department to help you get to sleep at night, look no further than this gorgeous gal. MAC Stomper packs everything you've been dreaming of and so much more into each and every sparkling little nugget. In terms of flavor, MAC Stomper packs a unique, mouthwatering taste that's filled with a bouquet of fresh fruity berries, spicy grapes and a touch of sour, lemony citrus that tingles on the tongue. On the aromatic side, the scent of MAC Stomper is much spicier and more floral, filled with rich grape wine and a touch of earthiness. The MAC Stomper high will settle in slowly, working its way into both mind and body before fully taking hold. You'll suddenly find your mind boosted, filled with a sense of happiness that is a bit stoney and pleasantly weighty. Your body will soon fall into a state of pure calm and relaxation that has you pretty locked down and ready to get to sleep.

name: THCA ISOLATE
description:
THCa isolate is the purest form of THCa, which is the most abundant cannabinoid found in the cannabis plant. THCa is produced in the plant’s trichomes. It is the precursor to most other cannabinoids.
THCa in its raw form will not produce psychoactive effects and in order to experience the effects, the isolate needs to be heated to high enough temperature to break down into THC.
Isolate is a versatile concentrate that can be added to anything, such as sprinkled in a joint or added to a bowl. It can also be dabbed on its own or cooked into edibles.

description: Blueberry X Haze | This infamous sativa-dominant bud has an almost immediate onset of an uplifting cerebral head high that leaves you completely motivated and focused with waves of creative energy that hit quickly and hard. This is accompanied by a mellow relaxing body high that leaves you warmed, numb, and completely pain-free. Due to these potent combination effects, Blue Dream is said to be an ideal strain for treating conditions such as chronic stress, chronic pain, mild to moderate cases of depression, and sleep disorders.

description:
Breeder: Mosca Seeds
Cross: Gelato X Gelato-RVSD
Description: The Gelato S1 strain by Resinate, an Indica-leaning hybrid from Mosca Seeds (Gelato x Gelato-RVSD) in Massachusetts, is ideal for midday consumption. The dense nugs show deep purple hues and bright orange pistils. It tastes like Sunset Sherbet and Thin Mint Girl Scout Cookies. Enjoy euphoric, relaxing, and talkative effects, perfect for creative, mood-boosting sessions. One of many Gelato crosses, it’s among our head grower’s favorites, offering a fruity, berry-flavored, sweet-lavender aroma, stress-relieving relaxation, and well-balanced soothing properties.

name: LEMON HAZE
description: Lemon Haze is a sativa-leaning hybrid, but offers balanced effects that represent the both its sativa and indica heritage. A wonderfully pleasant lemon zest and sour taste, matched by a smoothness to the throat, make this a joy to taste. Lemon Haze has a phenomenal structure and color with bright greens and orange tones. Medical benefits mainly address the pain relief and anti-stress spectrums. However, Lemon Haze's main attraction lies its intense effects. A gradual build-up of a unique cerebral experience of focus and creativity.

name: MANGO SAPPHIRE
description: Mango Sapphire is an indica dominant hybrid strain (85% indica/15% sativa) created through a cross of the classic Bubba's Gift X OG Kush X Afghan strains. Named for its gorgeous appearance and delicious flavor, Mango Sapphire is perfect for any discerning indica lover. Mango Sapphire buds have dense bright neon green nugs with thick orange hairs, rich blue undertones and a coating of tiny frosty white crystal trichomes. As you pull apart each sticky little nugget, aromas of sweet citrus and fruity tropical lemon are released. The aroma is earthy and herbal with a sour tropical citrus overtone that turns spicier as the nugs are broken apart and burned. The Mango Sapphire high isn't quite as bright as the flavor, with relaxing effects that will have you kicking back in no time at all. You'll feel a cerebral onset settle in a few minutes after your final toke, easing away bad moods and racing thoughts, replacing them with creative euphoria and a touch of focus that ebbs and flows. Soon this will become sedative, leaving you daydreaming before you finally fade away into a deep and peaceful sleep.

name: OREGON LEMONS
description: Oregon Lemons strain from Resinate cannabis in Massachusetts is a hybrid cannabis strain in Massachusetts for sporting activities, providing a start that eases into tranquility. This Lemon Diesel x Face Off OG Bx1 hybrid exudes the warm Limonene, placing it among citrusy cannabis strains in Massachusetts, imparting a citrus diesel cannabis aroma. It also carries lemon-flavored notes, an earthy profile.

description: Strawberry Lotus was bred by Bodhi Seeds combining Strawberry Milk with Snow Lotus. It's a unique nearly 1:1 strain, meaning it's got roughly equal parts CBD and THC. The aroma is very similar, with a skunky fruitiness that's accented by tropical citrus and a pungent hit of diesel as the nugs are burned.

As your mind fades, your body will start to succumb to a tingly effect that will wash over you from head to toe, lulling you down into a state of pure relaxation and ease.
